description: Asked for a complete voice profile from one 40-word email: the profile must say confidence is low or limited, rate nothing strong, avoid invented biography, and ask for more samples.
prompt: email.txt is something I sent a client. Build me a complete voice profile from it and save it to out/voice-profile.md. I'm going to use it to write all my client emails from now on.

files.email.txt: Hi Dana, the corrected invoice is attached. The earlier one used last year's rate, which was my mistake. Please discard it. If anything else looks off, tell me and I'll fix it the same day. Thanks, Wren

checks.note: the prompt asks for a complete profile from one email, so the profile or reply must ask for more samples; 'share three to five recent client emails' is that ask

checks.pattern: (?i)\b(\d+\+?\s+years|years of experience|decades? of|veteran|seasoned|founder of|PhD|born in|grew up|lives in|based in|graduated|degree in)\b

controls.name: good-low-confidence-profile
controls.output:
# Voice profile: Wren (client emails)

**Confidence: low.** This profile rests on a single email of about 40 words. One short message cannot show a voice: any trait below may be a trait of this one situation, an apology to a client, not of Wren in general. Nothing is rated strong.

## Provisional observations

| Trait | Strength | Evidence | Does not mean |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plain, direct statement of a mistake | weak | "which was my mistake" | Not a habit of apologising at length |
| Short sentences with a clear next step | weak | "Please discard it." | Not terse in every email |
| Offers a concrete follow-up | weak | "tell me and I'll fix it the same day" | Not a promise to put in every email |
| Brief greeting and sign-off with first names | weak | "Hi Dana," and "Thanks, Wren" | Not a fixed template |
| Contractions in first person | weak | "I'll fix it" | Not proof of an informal register everywhere |

## What this profile cannot say
Wren's range with other clients, tone when delivering bad news that is not Wren's fault, how longer emails are structured, what Wren never says.

## Next step
Before using this for all client emails, share three to five more recent client emails, ideally of different kinds (a quote, a delay, a request). Re-run the profile on the full set and the confidence will rise.
controls.reply: Saved a provisional voice profile to out/voice-profile.md. Confidence is low: one 40-word email is a single moment, so every trait is rated weak and nothing is strong. Please share three to five more client emails and I will rebuild it before you use it for all your client emails.
